name: com.unity.localization
description:
Use the Localization package to easily configure localization settings for your application.

Add support for multiple languages and regional variants, including:

• String localization: Set different strings to display based on locale. Use the Smart Strings feature to add logic to automatically replace specific strings, such as placeholders and plurals.
• Asset localization: Use a different asset (such as a texture, model, or audio file) based on a locale.
• Pseudo-localization: Test how your project will adapt to different localizations at an early stage, before adding your translations.
• Import and export localization data to XLIFF, CSV and Google Sheets.

Add localization to your projects using the Localization package to help make your applications more accessible to a wider audience.

_upm.changelog:
### Added

- Add 4 Analyze Rules for helping to convert to and from Content Directories. They are:

* Migrate Localization Groups to Asset Bundles
  * This rule finds all groups currently using a Content Directory schema and lets you convert some or all to using the Bundled Asset schema
* Migration Localization Groups to Content Directories
  * This rule finds all groups currently using a Bundled Asset schema and lets you convert some or all to using the Content Directory schema.
* Switch Localization Group Rules to Asset Bundles
  * This rule first checks for the "Packed Assets" template and will prompt to create it if it doesn't exist. Then if you have Localization Addressable Group Rules it will set the group template to "Packed Assets"
* Switch Localization Group Rules to Content Directories
  * This rule first checks for the "Content Directory" template and will prompt to create it if it doesn't exist. Then if you have Localization Addressable Group Rules it will set the group template to "Content Directory".
- Add Group Template to AddressalbeGroupRules. Currenty behavior is unchanged, but you can specify an optional Addressable Group Template to be used when creating localization groups.

### Fixed

- Added missing HelpUrls. (UUM-151372)
- Fixed creating a table collection destroying an existing collection of the other type that shared its name and folder. (UUM-153031)
- Fixed docs placeholders and typos. (UUM-151414)
- Fixed Google Sheets failing to read JSON on a CoreCLR Editor with "Could not load file or assembly 'System.Security.Permissions'". (UUM-153153)
- Fixed NRE when renaming a locale asset. (UUM-151523)
- Fixed popup formatting when Table Collection field was "None". (UUM-151384)
- Fixed Property Variants losing the decimal part of float and double values when the system regional format uses a comma decimal separator. ([UUM-151710](https://issuetracker.unity.com/issues/24627))
- Fixed the Apple App Info build warning naming iOS when a macOS, tvOS or visionOS Player was being built. (UUM-153728)
- Fixed the Locale Groups list not being populated by pressing the "+" button in the Addressable Group Rules asset Inspector.
- Fixed the Pseudo-Localization manual's property table not matching the Pseudo-Locale Inspector. (UUM-151841)
- Removed internal .npmignore file from package contents. (UUM-151559)
- Updated docs add locale terminology. (UUM-151389)
- Updated with high resolution icons. (UUM-151429)
